mapper.sql: user_account.id AS id, user_account.company_id AS company_id, user_account.username AS username, user_account.name AS name, user_account.email AS email, user_account.actor_type AS actor_type, CASE WHEN user_account.company_id IS NULL THEN 'WorkOps' ELSE company.name END AS company_name, CASE WHEN user_account.department_id IS NULL THEN '未設定' WHEN department.is_deleted = TRUE THEN CONCAT(department.name, '（削除済み）') ELSE department.name END AS department_name, COALESCE(( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(permission_set.code, ' / ', permission_set.name) ORDER BY permission_set.id SEPARATOR ', ') FROM user_permission_sets user_permission_set INNER JOIN permission_sets permission_set ON permission_set.id = user_permission_set.permission_set_id AND permission_set.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE user_permission_set.user_id = user_account.id ), '未設定') AS permission_set_display, user_account.cognito_sub AS cognito_sub, user_account.is_deleted AS is_deleted, user_account.created_at AS created_at, user_account.updated_at AS updated_at
LEFT JOIN companies company ON company.id = user_account.company_id LEFT JOIN departments department ON department.id = user_account.department_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM users user_account
WHERE user_account.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY user_account.actor_type ASC, company.name ASC, user_account.username ASC, user_account.id ASC

SELECT
FROM users user_account
WHERE user_account.id = #{userId} AND user_account.is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT
FROM users user_account
WHERE user_account.is_deleted = FALSE AND user_account.actor_type = 'TENANT' AND user_account.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY user_account.username ASC, user_account.id ASC
